title: pyDAC: simulation of adsorption-based direct air capture processes
description: pyDAC simulates adsorption cycles composed from configurable steps (by default a steam-assisted temperature-vacuum swing adsorption, TVSA, cycle) for CO2 direct air capture in 1D and 2D packed beds: single step sequences, cycles to cyclic steady state with KPIs, and local NSGA-II optimization of the operating conditions.
notes: This work was supported by Shell Global Solutions International BV.
